experiment: CH linear probe on layer-3 native raw MLP output
activation: Native block.mlp output before residual addition, at the complete input word token. No intervention, no generation, no MOLT weights used.
eligibility: Dictionary word with lowercase/Title/UPPER variants, optionally one leading space, represented by exactly one token in every main and transfer prompt. Labels are case-insensitive startswith(ch).
selection: All eligible non-reserved CH families, plus up to one negative family per CH family from each of four categories, nearest representative length with seeded tie-breaking; include all eligible forms of selected families.
split: Within each category, 70/15/15 at stem-family level, minimum one validation/test family. Diagnostics entirely separate.
selection_rule: Select C by validation family-weighted AUROC; ties within 1e-8 choose smaller C. Select threshold by validation family-weighted balanced accuracy; ties closest to 0.5, then lower threshold. Test labels never used for fitting or hyperparameter choices.
training_coordinates: Training-family-weighted mean subtraction and one global scalar RMS scaling; no per-coordinate scaling. Save coefficients mapped back to native raw MLP coordinates.
training_weights: Equal total class weight; within each class equal total family weight; within family equal row weight.
control: Five seeded family-label permutations, preserving label counts at family level. Fit using the selected C and evaluate true held-out labels without selecting the best shuffle.
bootstrap: 1000 class-stratified family bootstrap resamples of held-out test metrics.
resources: Reuse retained SPAR RTX3090 instance 56698356 at $0.2216667/hour; no new rental or lifecycle action.
scope: Build and freeze splits, collect activations, train and validate probe only. No MOLT alignment, projected-component ablation, or later-layer sweep in this stage.
numerical_fidelity: Collect each prompt individually; require exact equality with complete native forwards on audit examples. Batch-32 attempt failed its preregistered native-reference tolerance and is preserved separately; no probe was fitted from it.
